title: Victim sees UFO lights at Zorro Ranch and wakes in a lab

tellings.quote:
I saw a UFO when I was there, you know,
outside at New Mexico. I went to have a
cigarette and I saw a weird like lights
flying and then I had the weird thing
waking up in the lab.

plain: Around 2002, at Zorro Ranch in New Mexico, a property tied in the episode to the financier Jeffrey Epstein, a woman stepped outside for a cigarette, saw strange lights flying overhead, and later woke up in what she calls a lab. Juliet Byron, who presents herself as one of the victims there, tells it from her own experience: "I saw a weird like lights flying and then I had the weird thing waking up in the lab." If true, it would tie the ranch to both UFOs and experiments on people.
